title: These tech execs stood out as the big winners and losers in a turbulent Q3 (AMZN, FB, AAPL, INTC, AMD, SNAP, GOOGL, NFLX, DBX, ROKU)
text: These tech execs stood out as the big winners and losers in a turbulent Q3 (AMZN, FB, AAPL, INTC, AMD, SNAP, GOOGL, NFLX, DBX, ROKU) By Troy Wolverton Nov 13, 2018, 7:39 pm 30 pts The third quarter was a tough one in the tech business. Scandals abounded. Many companies saw their sales growth slow or user numbers falter. Stocks that once seemed to defy gravity, got knocked down. And the president of the United States made a sport out of publicly attacking many companies and…
